newsitem.title: USA: AM Best rates Munich Reinsurance debt.
newsitem.headline: AM Best rates Munich Reinsurance debt.

text.p: Insurance rating agency A. M. Best Co on Monday said it has assigned Munich Reinsurance Co of Munich, Germany, an "A++" or Superior rating.

The rating is assigned to certain of the company's core and strategic subsidiaries that operate on a coordinated basis around the world, providing a full array of Munich Re's products, services and capacity.
These core group members include Munich Re in Toronto, Canada, Munich Re in Sydney, Australia, Munich Re in Johannesburg, South Africa, Munich Re in Milan, Italy, and New Re in Geneva, Switzerland.
A.M. Best said Munich Re was placed under review with the announcement of the acquisition of American Re Corp.
